findings.defect: This changes the physical sensation from ears feeling muffled or blocked to ringing.
findings.rationale: The source says 귓가가 먹먹하다, describing a muffled sensation in his ears, not tinnitus.

findings.current: Together, they struck with more destructive force than he could withstand even with his Scorching Yang Qi pushed to its limit.
findings.defect: “Pushed to its limit” says his Scorching Yang Qi reached its maximum; the source instead specifies that he raised it explosively.
findings.rationale: The source says 폭발적으로 끌어올린 열양지기, specifying the manner in which he increased his Scorching Yang Qi, not that he necessarily reached its limit.
findings.replacement: Together, their destructive power was more than he could withstand, even with his Scorching Yang Qi raised explosively.

summary: Two minor fidelity issues: a change to the described ear sensation and a lost detail about how Jin Taekyung raises his Scorching Yang Qi.
